# Medplix.AI

> AI-powered hospital, clinic, lab & pharmacy management software for India. Cloud SaaS — works anywhere in India with fully remote demo, onboarding, data migration and staff training. INR pricing, GST-compliant billing. Also: custom-built healthcare software, healthcare website design, digital marketing for healthcare, and free prescription software for medical students.

Medplix.AI ("Your Intelligent HealthTech Partner") is a cloud healthcare platform by **Medplix AI Private Limited** (CIN U62013MR2026PTC477850, registered office: Innov8 Q Parc, Ghansoli/Rabale, Thane 400701, Maharashtra, India). It covers OPD, IPD, ICU, OT, laboratory (LIS), pharmacy, GST-ready billing, HR/payroll, owner dashboards & analytics, wholesale procurement (Medplix Bazaar) and AI Connect — a secure, read-only, tenant-isolated connector that links an owner's business data to AI assistants. Key positioning: Medplix is not just prescription software — it is a living link between a practice and its patients (teleconsultation, online appointments, digital prescriptions & reports, follow-up reminders, online payments).

## Software products & pricing (per month, billed annually, excluding GST)

- [Medplix HMS — Complete Hospital Suite](https://www.medplix.ai/product-hms.html): OPD, IPD, ICU/OT, lab, pharmacy, billing, HR & marketing. ₹1,250/mo.
- [Medplix Clinic](https://www.medplix.ai/product-clinic.html): appointments, EMR, prescriptions, lab, pharmacy & daycare. ₹499/mo.
- [Medplix Labs (LIS)](https://www.medplix.ai/product-labs.html): billing, sample tracking, auto reports & referrals. ₹499/mo.
- [Medplix Pharmacy](https://www.medplix.ai/product-pharmacy.html): POS billing, inventory, batch & expiry, GST accounting. ₹499/mo.
- Add-ons: extra desktop/mobile login ₹299/mo each; Medplix AI Connect ₹499/mo.

Free 1-month trial, no card required. Setup, data migration and staff training are included and done remotely.

## Services

- [Custom-built healthcare software](https://www.medplix.ai/#custom-build): a hospital's own system built around its workflows — pick modules, module-based pricing, 100% customizable.
- [Healthcare website design](https://www.medplix.ai/#web-design): modern websites for clinics/hospitals/labs/pharmacies with appointment forms, branding and Google-ready SEO.
- [Digital marketing for healthcare](https://www.medplix.ai/#digital-marketing): Google Ads, Google Business Profile, local SEO, social campaigns, monthly lead/ROI reports.
- [Free for medical students & interns](https://www.medplix.ai/#students): free digital prescription software — write Rx, share on WhatsApp, build a patient base, track history. 100% free, no card.
- Mobile apps: Medplix Care (patient app), Medplix Pulse (staff app), Medplix Meds (medicine ordering).

## Key facts

- Made for India: INR pricing, GST-compliant billing in every state, multi-branch support across cities. Serves customers pan-India, fully remotely.
- Focus regions: **Andhra Pradesh & Telangana first** — demos, staff training and day-to-day support are available **in Telugu** (also English and Hindi). Telugu landing page: https://www.medplix.ai/telugu.html
- City & town pages (Andhra Pradesh/Telangana focus): Hyderabad, Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam, Guntur, Nellore, Tirupati, Rajahmundry, Kakinada, Ongole, Vizianagaram, Srikakulam, Eluru, Bhimavaram, Machilipatnam, Narasaraopet, Anakapalli, Chirala, Chittoor, Warangal, Karimnagar, Nizamabad, plus Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune and Delhi NCR (all at https://www.medplix.ai/hospital-management-software-<city>.html).
- Security: encryption in transit and at rest, automatic daily backups, role-based access, audit trails, tenant isolation. Data is exportable anytime (no lock-in).
- 24/7 support on WhatsApp, phone and email.
- Medplix.AI is a software provider; it does not provide medical advice.
